notes: Top tokens also include ' so' ('if you are so inclined', not tested here) and digits. The + pole fires on '2', ' two', ' double', so counts seem to split across the poles. Probes: three- 0.30-0.45, two- 0.11, five- 0.07, ten- 0.06.
